text: Small business focusing on hand-made keychains, stickers, and jewellery of things that make me happy!

A quick back story of my store is that I'm a designer who always loved making art and crafts, so I decided to take the leap last year to set up my Etsy store and start tabling at vendor markets in Toronto. I've been a vendor in four markets so far, and I love the community that comes by supporting local vendors and the opportunity to connect with customers.
I set up my Etsy store in 2024. Since then, I've learned a lot about marketing, pricing, customer experience, and the international shipping process.

All of the products and art work I design are handmade and custom designed and inspired by characters that bring me joy. I started off by making jewelry and gradually expanded into polymer clay keychains, stickers, and custom orders.
